provisional_source_tokens.observation: and he swore: perfect 3 masculine singular, not first person
in/by a name: b + construct noun
great: modifier of name
that: clause complement
afterward/hereafter: temporal, not because
he would/will not do: negative i + 3 masculine singular verb
thus, like this: demonstrative expression
to/for all of them: l + universal + 3 plural suffix
who/those who: relative plural
they dwell: 3 plural imperfect, inhabitants not a new singular actor
on/upon
dry land: dry/solid ground as place, not sea
and the sign/token of: conjunct plus construct noun
circuit/circle: not an added colored rainbow definition
in the heavens: b + plural skies
and let it be: 3 masculine singular subjunctive/jussive, not I will put
between me: maekel with first singular form
and between them: conjunct and 3 plural suffix humu
faithfulness/fidelity, reliability: not a second word for oath
until, up to
forever/to eternity: l + alam
as long as/to the extent of: nominal measure word in temporal construct use
days of: plural construct
heaven/sky: singular noun in the duration phrase
over/above/on
earth/land
and this: conjunct demonstrative
by/in my command: b + command + first singular possession
it is: third-person copular pronoun, not a new action

provisional_whole_english: And he swore by a great name that afterward he would not do thus to all those who inhabit dry land. And let the sign of the circle in the heavens be between me and them as faithfulness forever, as long as the days of heaven over the earth; and this is by my command.
grammar_observations: Finite forms: mahal[a] perfect 3ms he swore; i-ye-gaber 3ms negative imperfect under that with prospective reference; yenaberu 3pl present/general inhabitants; ye-kun 3ms short/subjunctive used jussively let it be, not first-person I will put. Final weetu supplies copular is. First singular is solely between me and my command, requiring English quotation/speech presentation or explicit note of source shift without rewriting third person swore/does. 1907 printed170-171 imperfect future/present/habitual uses; printed204 gives third-person prefix and masculine plural u; printed205 perfect attached personal signs; printed349 includes gabara examples but deals with suffixes, not a complete jussive syntax demonstration. Lexicon kina entry pp861-862 lists subj yekun as control. No independent finite verb for duration is printed.
critical_observations: Stars visible before word18 and word27; closing square bracket then spaced dots after word29, before next baseline3. Footnotes21-32 belong to this unit and document edited choices/variants (27 suffix alternate,31 command/deictic phrasing,32 omission); they do not license claiming manuscript-autograph certainty or erasing editorial condition. I have read the printed apparatus as edition evidence, not collated original MSS. Needs concise verse-click explanation for selected text and awkward duration/third-to-first-person shift; cannot fix by smoothing into remembered Bible story.

latin_observations.observation: Actual cols155-156: mahala I1 jurare, jusjurandum dare; swearing with b is licensed. Noun oath entry at col156 means juratio/juramentum/jusjurandum. This noun is NOT what the native image has at words17-18; those proved maekel. Page157 starts the next mercy root, confirming boundary.

Actual col14 complete haymanot entry through boundary before its derivatives: fides qua creditur; also fides qua credimur/fidelitas (friendship example), then specifically fides vera crectu, and creed/confession use. Contextual fidelity is lexically supported; theological belief is not compulsory. Derivative continuation top15 does not turn word19 into oath.

Actual col784 complete maekel entry continues into785: medium/media pars/medius locus; accusative maekela is prepositional in media re/in mediam rem, inter, repeated between X and between Y. Pronoun suffix syntax supplies me and them. Adjacent derived nouns in785 are distinct entries, not the source noun.

Actual cols221-223 full matana entry and nominal uses: measure/estimate; substantive mensura/modus/ratio; construct matana marks quantum/tantum and temporal quoad, quamdiu, dum, tamdiu. This is as long as, not a separate verb remain/continue and not measure in physical units.

Actual col1000 complete awd entry with continuation1001: circuitus, ambitus, circulus; linea circumcurrens, orbis, periodus anni, circus solaris, locus circumseptus, area, threshing-floor and forum contexts. Here lexical circle/circuit with heavens chooses spatial circle, not a claimed explicit rainbow-color word.
Actual cols340-341 full sem/name entry and next semay entry: nomen, fama, memoria and authority uses; semay coelum with plural samayat. Name and heavens distinct and both constructs supported.

Actual col730 taamara verb passage is lumin praebere, apparere, prodigium; col731/732 related nouns include signum/indicium, insigne, omen and demonstratio/significatio/indicium/ostentum. Source construct sign/token need not be rendered miracle. Entry boundaries inspected across 730-732.

Actual col951 alam entire entry into952: aevum/saeculum/tempus antiquum and future perpetual time/aeternitas. lealam marks in aeternum/perpetuum; mundus/terrarum senses are separate, and not selected for this adverbial duration.

Actual command root azaza starts792; complete command noun teezaz in793-794 means praeceptum, mandatum, officium, statutum, jussus. First singular suffix in source yields my command; no necessity to invent because I command a second finite verb.
Actual1071-1072: yebes siccus/aridus and noun terra arida, sicca/continens as opposed to water. Whole entry read, not only the quoted gloss.
Actual1103-1105 diba entry: super/supra/in, over/upon; multiple temporal/causal/oppositional uses inspected. Here locative above/on earth; source has no independent duration verb.
Actual cols815-816 universal pronoun continuation and prepositional uses support all of them; no second set of inhabitants introduced.
Actual aby root and abiy adjective entry: magnus and time/coetus uses; here it modifies name. Whole adjective and continuation inspected.

Actual gabara I1 and II1, III1 entries through1162: facere/agere, creation/work/performance, perfecting/completing and passive/reflexive senses distinguished. Source igaber is third singular negative doing, not a passive of the inhabitants.

Actual nabara entry starts650, complete I1 continues651: sedere, stay/remain/esse, vivere/morari/habitare. Then causative II1 begins651-652. Source third plural yenaberu active inhabit/dwell, not causative place them.
Actual eske entry cols750-751: dum/usque dum/donec/quoad and preposition usque/ad. Combined forever phrase marks continuation to eternity, no negation transferred here.
